title: Anthropic Provider Token Reporting Issues with Telemetry

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/anthropic): correct raw usage information
linked_prs.body:
## Background

When streaming, the Anthropic API sends raw usage information in different chunks. We only considered initial chunks, causing #8795

## Summary

Merge raw usage information from initial and following chunks. Also enables inclusion of tool usage counts.

## Related Issues

Fixes #8795
